evidence_frontier: Exp021 (PNN‑v1‑Exp021) evaluated ECG200 with a 4,278‑parameter w8 compression candidate. The candidate achieved 887 aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions versus 897 for the w16 control (10 fewer) over 1,000 predictions (10 seeds). The experiment retained Alpha5 as active. The next preregistered question is to confirm the w8 boundary using an integer‑count gate across a fresh 5‑seed set.
analysis: Observation: In Exp021 the w8 candidate was exactly 10 correct predictions worse than the w16 control when aggregated over 10 seeds (1,000 predictions). The human reviewer clarified that the success gate must be applied to the aggregate correct count across all five seeds, not per‑seed, using the inequality alpha5_w8.aggregate_qant_correct >= alpha5_w16_control.aggregate_qant_correct - 10. Hypothesis: The w8 compression will reproduce this performance relationship on an independent 5‑seed evaluation, staying within the 10‑prediction tolerance.
hypothesis: When evaluated on a fresh set of five random seeds, the Alpha5 w8 local‑width candidate will achieve an aggregate Q.ANT correct count that is no more than ten predictions lower than the Alpha5 w16 control on the ECG200 test set (i.e., candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10).

proposal.title: Confirmation of w8 Local‑Width Boundary on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Does the w8 compressed local representation preserve performance within the 10‑prediction tolerance of the w16 control across a fresh five‑seed evaluation?
proposal.rationale: Exp021 demonstrated a borderline 10‑prediction drop for w8 versus w16 over ten seeds. To establish reproducibility and satisfy the integer‑count gating required by the review, a confirmation experiment with a new seed set and the exact aggregate‑correct gate is needed before any further architectural changes.

procedure: Generate a fresh list of five independent random seeds (different from those used in Exp021).
For each seed, train the Alpha5 architecture with local_width = 16 (control) on the ECG200 training set and evaluate on the ECG200 test set, recording per‑seed correct predictions.
For each seed, train the Alpha5 architecture with local_width = 8 (candidate) under identical training hyper‑parameters and evaluate on the same test set, recording per‑seed correct predictions.
Aggregate the correct counts across all five seeds for both control and candidate (total predictions = 5 × 100 = 500).
Apply the success gate: candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10.

proposal.success_criteria: If the aggregated Q.ANT correct count for the w8 candidate is greater than or equal to the w16 control count minus ten (candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10) on the fresh five‑seed evaluation (denominator 500 predictions), the confirmation succeeds.
proposal.risks: Potential variance due to the reduced number of seeds may cause the candidate to fall just outside the 10‑prediction margin despite true equivalence; limited compute budget may restrict hyper‑parameter tuning; simulation backend may exhibit stochastic effects not captured by seed control.
